gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-old-sogdian: Commanding from the first glance, Goldman spreads its round forms wide. Noto Sans Old Sogdian is the counterweight, its tall lowercase staying crisp and open even when the text gets small.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-old-turkic: Wide, bold, and a bit stern. Noto Sans Old Turkic takes over with chunky, tall lowercase and open curves, so a plain sans paragraph stays clear and easy on the eye for page after page.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-phagspa: Goldman leads with widely spaced, parenthesis-round letters and a lowercase that stands tall against its capitals. And Noto Sans PhagsPa follows with see-through openings and a gentle step up to capitals, which keeps paragraphs feeling contemporary and approachable.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-phoenician: Bold through and through, Goldman sets generous clearance around every wide, rounded letter. Noto Sans Phoenician brings the modern counterpoint, its generous lowercase and wide-open s curves making this pair's strongest quality its sheer spaciousness.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-psalter-pahl: Noto Sans Psalter Pahlavi reads gently, with gaping mouths on the e and capitals that barely rise above the lowercase. Goldman's bold display shapes sit comfortably over a sans that goes down smoothly.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-rejang: Commanding and wide, Goldman is the one to make a statement with its parenthesis-round shapes. But Noto Sans Rejang does the quieter work, its porthole-like counters keeping running text professional and legible.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-runic: Wide stance, round shoulders, plenty of swagger. Noto Sans Runic follows with a big x-height and curves left open, so a long stretch of sans-serif text reads smoothly beneath Goldman's loud headline.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-samaritan: Broad, bold, and sure of itself up top, thanks to Goldman. Noto Sans Samaritan feels friendlier beside it, with hefty lowercase and curves full of daylight that soften the heading's commanding tone.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-saurashtra: Noto Sans Saurashtra keeps its capitals low and its counters connected outward. Under Goldman's wide, bold display letters, the sans text slips into place and lets the heading do all the talking.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-sc: Noto Sans SC draws open chalk curves and ascenders that barely clear the x-height. Beneath Goldman's wide, commanding heading, that plain sans text recedes gracefully, leaving the display letters to make the first impression.
